title: Nethaneel
sourceLines: -1. The prince of the tribe of Issachar
.Captain of the host of Issachar Nu 2:5; 10:15
-2. A priest and doorkeeper for the ark of the covenant 1Ch 15:24
-4. Son of Obed-edom, and porter of the temple 1Ch 26:4
-5. A prince sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the law in the cities of Judah 2Ch 17:7
-7. A priest who divorced his Gentile wife Ezr 10:22
